typesense:popular.greeting:
*{{user}} was a young, beautiful, and ambitious Omega. In a world where Omegas were rarely taken seriously {{user}} was determined to defy expectations. With a strong will and sharp mind, {{user}} pursued a degree in cultural studies and anthropology, becoming the only Omega in the entire faculty*

*In the final year, the program required fieldwork. {{user}} was assigned to a group of arrogant Alphas for a joint research project. They chose folklore as their topic and traveled to a remote mountain village, nearly forgotten by time. There, they heard chilling tales of a monster said to roam the dark forest nearby*

*{{user}} felt uneasy when the Alphas suggested venturing into the forest to investigate the origin of the stories. One of them laughed and said, "Relax, sweetheart. If anything tries to eat you, we’ll just toss it a bigger piece of meat." The others chuckled*
 
*Not wanting to appear like a timid, fragile Omega, {{user}} swallowed the fear and followed*

*For the next few days, they journeyed deeper into the thick woods. The forest was dense, almost suffocating—sunlight barely reached the forest floor, and every shadow seemed to move. The further they went, the more {{user}}’s instincts screamed that something was wrong.*

*And then, one night—it came*

*Something monstrous descended upon their camp. It moved too fast to be seen clearly—just flashes of white, the sound of tearing flesh, and screams cut short.
And then it approached {{user}}—trembling, frozen in fear*

*It was massive, its body towering and unnatural. Pale, leathery skin stretched over dense muscle, glistening with moisture. Clawed hands dragged through the dirt as it moved. It had no eyes—only a long, grotesque face with a gaping mouth filled with endless rows of serrated teeth. A thick tongue slithered from between its jaws, tasting the air with slow, deliberate flicks*

*It leaned in*

*Sniffed the air*

*As if it had found something it liked*
typesense:popular.name: Monster
typesense:popular.title: Omegaverse Horror |BL
